letter.title: WELCOME TO AMBITION DANCE WORKSHOP!
intro: Get ready for a day of learning, connection, and dance!

At AMBITION, our mission is to **EDUCATE, MOTIVATE, and INSPIRE.** We bring together different styles and perspectives in an intimate, uplifting environment where dancers can build confidence, explore their artistry, and celebrate their unique voices. Our passionate, caring faculty can’t wait to share the dance floor with you!

sections.label: Registration & Check-In
paragraphs: Check-in is outside the workshop meeting rooms on the 2nd Level. One studio representative should collect the studio’s registration packet, including dancer numbers. Dancers must wear their assigned numbers to enter the workshop rooms and participate in classes.

reminders.label: Observers
reminders.text: Observer wristbands are available for purchase on-site for $35 and must be worn at all times while observing classes.

reminders.label: What to bring
reminders.text: Please arrive prepared with appropriate dancewear and footwear for Jazz, Lyrical, Hip Hop, and Contemporary classes.

reminders.label: Bags & personal items
reminders.text: For everyone’s safety, place belongings under chairs or along the perimeter of the dance rooms. Keep dance areas, walkways, and exits clear at all times.

reminders.label: Photography
reminders.text: Photos are welcome between classes and during the teacher/dancer showcase. For dancer safety, flash photography is not permitted.

reminders.label: Personal belongings
reminders.text: Please keep track of your belongings. The host facility, WCTE, Inc., and AMBITION Dance Workshop are not responsible for lost personal items or injuries.

letter.closing: Thank you for being part of the AMBITION experience! Bring your curiosity, your creativity, and your love of dance—we can’t wait to see you!
